evidence: Carries the Fuzzing label and updates fuzz infrastructure in src/test/fuzz/util/wallet.h and the spend fuzz harness.
rationale: Significantly accelerates wallet fuzzing throughput by 4x to 6x by reusing a single FuzzedWallet instance instead of reimporting descriptors on each iteration. The PR description reports a "~6x speedup on an Ubuntu machine without sanitizers," which was confirmed by reviewer jeanpablojp who noted "the speedup reproduces, around 4x here."
